text.en: 1. This Act may be cited as the Statutory Declarations Act,

2. It shall be lawful for any President of a Sessions Court,
Magistrate, Commissioner for Oaths or, subject to the
provisions of section 4 of the Notaries Public Ordinance,
1959, any notary public appointed under the Notaries Public
Ordinance, 1959, to take and receive the declaration of any
person voluntarily making the same in Malay or English in
the form in the Schedule.

3. Declarations made by virtue of the provisions of this Act
shall be deemed to be such declarations as are referred to
in sections 199 and 200 of the Penal Code.

4, A person making any declaration by virtue of the
provisions of this Act shall pay to the officer or Commis-
sioner taking the same such fees as the Minister may
from time to time by notification in the Gazette prescribe.

5. Any reference in any federal law in force in Sabah to the
Statutory Declarations Ordinance of Sabah and any
reference in any federal law in force in Sarawak to the
Statutory Declarations Ordinance of Sarawak or to the
Statutory Declarations Act, 1835, of the United Kingdom,
shall be deemed to be a reference to this Act.
